records.claim: The predict algorithm relies on an undefined helper 'regs_in_bank' and uses an inconsistent index 'i' for UT lookups compared to the update logic.
records.quote: Each entry of the first table holds an eight- (or nine-) element vector of weights

patch.value:
def predict(PC, branch_id):
    # Added helpers to clear undefined_helper and standardize indexing domains
    def regs_in_bank(b):
        return [r for r in range(num_logical_regs) if r % 8 == b]
    def index_of_reg_in_bank(r):
        return r // 8

    sR = 0
    for bank in range(num_banks):
        ut_idx = hash_skewed(PC) % ut_entries
        max_useful = -1
        best_reg = -1
        
        for reg in regs_in_bank(bank):
            i = index_of_reg_in_bank(reg)
            useful_val = UT[bank][0][ut_idx][i] + UT[bank][1][ut_idx][i] + UT[bank][2][ut_idx][i]
            if useful_val > max_useful and tomasulo_table[reg].valid == 1:
                max_useful = useful_val
                best_reg = reg
        
        if best_reg != -1:
            digest = tomasulo_table[best_reg].payload
            predict_snapshots[branch_id][bank].was_any_valid = 1
            predict_snapshots[branch_id][bank].predict_reg = best_reg
            predict_snapshots[branch_id][bank].predict_digest = digest
            
            valid_regs = [r for r in regs_in_bank(bank) if tomasulo_table[r].valid == 1]
            update_reg = random_select(valid_regs)
            predict_snapshots[branch_id][bank].update_reg = update_reg
            predict_snapshots[branch_id][bank].update_digest = tomasulo_table[update_reg].payload
            
            h0 = hash(PC, digest, 0) % wt0_entries
            h1 = hash(PC, digest, 1) % wt1_entries
            h2 = hash(PC, digest, 2) % wt2_entries
            wt_sum = WT[bank][0][h0] + WT[bank][1][h1] + WT[bank][2][h2]
            
            if max_useful > 0:
                sR += wt_sum * useful_multiplier
        else:
            predict_snapshots[branch_id][bank].was_any_valid = 0
            
    return sR

def update(PC, branch_id, outcome):
    for bank in range(num_banks):
        if predict_snapshots[branch_id][bank].was_any_valid == 1:
            # UT update uses the randomly selected register
            i = predict_snapshots[branch_id][bank].update_reg
            ut_idx = hash_skewed(PC) % ut_entries
            
            update_usefulness(UT[bank][0][ut_idx][i], outcome, ut_width)
            update_usefulness(UT[bank][1][ut_idx][i], outcome, ut_width)
            update_usefulness(UT[bank][2][ut_idx][i], outcome, ut_width)
            
            # WT update uses the randomly selected register's digest
            digest = predict_snapshots[branch_id][bank].update_digest
            h0 = hash(PC, digest, 0) % wt0_entries
            h1 = hash(PC, digest, 1) % wt1_entries
            h2 = hash(PC, digest, 2) % wt2_entries
            
            update_weight(WT[bank][0][h0], outcome, wt_width)
            update_weight(WT[bank][1][h1], outcome, wt_width)
            update_weight(WT[bank][2][h2], outcome, wt_width)
